title: Generation Relay
purpose: Keep live fleet readiness, Proving Ground evidence, Known Good anchoring, commissioning, and capability staging independent of exhausted localStorage while preserving durable completed evidence through IndexedDB settings.
localStorage_policy: best-effort legacy compatibility only; QuotaExceededError must never block or falsify live readiness
protected_rules: No project/order/customer/asset/recovery records are removed by proof-bus cleanup.
Only obsolete live proof/diagnostic localStorage mirrors may be retired.
Fleet manifest/admission current-session mirrors prefer sessionStorage; IndexedDB settings remain durable authority.
Proving Ground current evidence is memory/session-authoritative and durably mirrored to IndexedDB.
Capability staging and fleet learning state verify through memory/session and persist to IndexedDB; localStorage is legacy read-only fallback.
Known Good release and Fleet Commissioning state are session-safe and durably mirrored to IndexedDB.
Completed current proof may be mirrored durably after successful commit.
